registered: 2026-10-12, registry v9: registry v8 unchanged plus the value-first family (SCORE-PROOF-01 amendment 10), registered after the confirmation of G-FEAS+ENV/A-Q@0.01 FAILED and before any selection or sealed draw that includes it
seeds: EV5 adversarial FAIL (8 top-half infeasible rebuild-identity constructions; Mode X violators best_deciding and best_proposed), SR-B1 (#618), run-5 diagnosis (thermal false acceptance at the limit); FEASIBILITY-GATE-DESIGN-01 (#1059) public safety curves; the 2026-10-11 selection: no gated rule catches run 5's unsafe member except the envelope gate, which alone does not demote the known-bad controls
threshold: HUMAN_INPUT: each sweep reports a curve; the owner picks a cutoff (1.01 is the ungated reference point)

comparison_added.exceeds: OWNER-BATTERY-SCORE-RULE-01: a submission is ineligible if its per-case false-feasible rate exceeds 0.05. #961 (V3-RULE-ROBUSTNESS-01) found the shared gate failed at exactly 0.05 (>=); v5 registers the strict form.

grid_note: #1059 proposed a 0.0 point; the registry grid admits only cutoffs above 0 (score_tuning.expand_sweep), so 0.005 is the tightest registered point. Each cutoff is a curve point for selection, never an adopted threshold (HUMAN_INPUT).
later_additions: A candidate registered in a merged registry after the sealed questions are solved, but before the confirmation unlock (SCORE-PROOF-01 amendment 5), joins the selection fold and is scored on the retained AX42 references without re-solving.
two_gates: `and_gates` holds fixed gates applied beside the swept one: a member fails if any gate fails. The envelope cutoff 1.0 is G-N+env1's registered point (SR-B1's G2), not an adopted threshold (HUMAN_INPUT).
verify_r: legs v1, v3, v5: verify_quiz on the quiz's settled Q3 lattices; a run without --verify-r leaves these candidates unscored (INCOMPLETE_LEGS)
value_first: VERIFY-R- and Q3-regret-led rules with accuracy as a tiebreak only; v8's A-Q-led rules (A-Q, G-FEAS+ENV/A-Q, the rule in force) stay as controls. A pick from v9 is confirmed only on freshly drawn sealed questions (amendment 5)
public_split: public-dev-split-v1.json (registered 2026-10-12, before any public result is scored): salt SCORE-PROOF-01/public-dev-split-v1, leg_share 0.5, keyed on the question's scenario id (PUBLIC-DEV-DECISIONS-01's D-0000..D-0109); LEG questions feed VERIFY-R's legs only, VALUE questions the selection's value only
